title: Intent and Approach Towards Criteria for New Energy Efficiency Grant for SMEs
what_it_is: Intent and Approach Towards Criteria for New Energy Efficiency Grant for SMEs

sections.label: Energy Efficiency Grant for SMEs
sections.summary: The Minister was asked about the intent and approach of the new Energy Efficiency Grant for SMEs and whether more companies will be encouraged to be energy-efficient at a systems level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry with regards to the criteria for the new Energy Efficiency Grant for SMEs (a) what is the Ministry's intent and approach towards it; and (b) whether the Ministry plans to encourage more companies to be more energy-efficient at a systems level, that is, a total solution towards gaining energy efficiency by tiering the grants or focusing on specific capital investments, in order to gain momentum first.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We have focused on these six categories of equipment because they tend to be energy intensive and are used for long hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The types of equipment supported under each category are selected based on technologies that have been identified as energy-efficient or have high-efficiency ratings, under NEA's Mandatory Energy Labelling Scheme.

sections.label: NEA Energy Efficiency Fund support
sections.summary: NEA's Energy Efficiency Fund supports manufacturing companies with resource-efficient designs and energy management systems, and SMEs can use affordable energy assessments from the Energy Efficiency Technology Centre.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: NEA's Energy Efficiency Fund (EEF) provides support for companies in the manufacturing sector, including the integration of resource-efficient designs into new facilities and the installation of energy management information systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In addition, SMEs can also tap on affordable energy assessments that is offered by the Energy Efficiency Technology Centre (EETC), which is a collaboration between NEA and the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT), to help them make informed decisions on the kind of measures to take to improve their energy efficiency.

sections.label: Schemes for SME green transformation
sections.summary: Schemes and measures have been rolled out to support SMEs in green transformation at system level, including the BCA's GMIS-EB 2.0 for building owners with co-funding of up to 50%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And that is why, over the past few years, in particular, we have rolled out many schemes and measures that supports our SMEs to make the green transformation at system level, be it acquiring expertise, skills, technology or even capability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, for example, for SMEs that are building owners, they will be able to apply for the BCA's Green Mark Incentive Scheme for Existing Buildings 2.0 (GMIS-EB 2.0), because this provides building owners, including SMEs, with co-funding support of up to 50% to help them to retrofit and to help them raise the energy performance of their building.

sections.label: Energy Efficiency Grant rollout details
sections.summary: The Energy Efficiency Grant will be rolled out for SMEs in three sectors from 1 September 2022 to 31 March 2023, providing up to 70% support to adopt energy efficiency equipment in pre-approved categories.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, we want to help them to see how to manage that and become more competitive and bring the business costs down.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is why, we are going to roll out the Energy Efficiency Grant (EEG), the SMEs in these three sectors can apply for the EEG starting 1 September 2022 to 31 March 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Now, this grant will allow the SMEs in these three sectors to obtain a support of up to 70% to adopt energy efficiency equipment in the pre-approved categories that I have mentioned.

sections.label: Equipment eligibility and applicant suggestions
sections.summary: Eligibility is based on NEA's High Efficiency Rating, and applicants may suggest other equipment or technology within the six supportable categories with higher or similar energy efficiency.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And the other one will be based on the High Efficiency Rating by NEA's mandatory energy labelling scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that, for any SME clients that have other equipment and would like to apply, the applicants may suggest other kinds of equipment or even technology within this six supportable categories that has higher or similar level of energy efficiency.
